title.narrative: Vihaan: Accelerating the National HIV Response to achieve the 95-95-95 targets through a community led, rights-based, prevention to care approach - India (01-Apr-2021-31-Mar-2024)

description.narrative: India, HIV, India HIV/AIDS Alliance (IHAA)This program has the following goals: Achieving zero new infections, zero AIDS-related deaths and zero AIDS related stigma & discrimination. The objectives of this program are: Reduce new infections by 80% by 2024. Link 95% of estimated PLHIV to services by 2024. Ensure ART initiation and retention of 95% PLHIV for sustained viral suppression by 2024. Eliminate mother-to-child transmission of HIV and syphilis by 2020. Eliminate HIV/AIDS related stigma and discrimination by 2020. Facilitate sustainable NACP service delivery by 2024
